phases.name: df212-team
phases.description: DF2.12 live round: one dispatch_task team (lead + two workers) whose cost events must each land as a cost_attribution line on the engine log; the task is pure arithmetic Q&A so every micro of spend is token spend attributable by roster role.
phases.task: You lead a two-worker team. Immediately spawn BOTH workers, worker-a and worker-b. Ask worker-a exactly: Reply with only the number: 17*23. Ask worker-b exactly: Reply with only the number: 31*37. When both replies arrive, finish with a JSON object of shape {"changedFiles": [], "result": {"summary": "worker-a=<first answer> worker-b=<second answer>"}}. Do not modify any files.
